CREATE VIEW [EDS].[PBI_VIEW_CBC01_RBB_CUSTOMER] AS SELECT CUST.ORGKEY AS [Customer ID]
               , CUST.Name AS [Customer Name]
               , CONCAT(CUST.Name, ' - ', CUST.ORGKEY) AS [Customer Name ID]
               , MV_GENDER.DESCRIPTION AS Gender
               , CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS [Customer Since]
               , EMAIL.EMAIL AS Email
               , PHONE.PHONENO AS Mobile
               , CONCAT(ADDRESS.ADDRESS_LINE1, ' ', ADDRESS.ADDRESS_LINE2, ', ', ADDRESS.CITY, ', ', ADDRESS.[STATE], ', ', ADDRESS.ZIP, ', ', ADDRESS.COUNTRY) AS [Address]
               , DEMOGRAPHIC.MARITAL_STATUS AS [Marital Status]
               , OCCUPATION.STRTEXT2 AS Occupation
               , CONCAT(DATENAME(MONTH, CUST.CUST_DOB), ' ', YEAR(CUST.CUST_DOB)) AS [Date of Birth]
               , AMLKYC.KYC_DATE AS [Last KYC Date]
               , RISKRATING.STRTEXT20 AS [Risk Rating Type]
               , RISKRATING.STRTEXT21 AS [Risk Rating Name]
               ,'TBD' [ATM Cash Card]---, CASE WHEN CUST.ORGKEY IN (SELECT CLT_CIF_NUMBER FROM EDS.ATM_CLIENT WHERE SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END [ATM Cash Card]
               , 'TBD' [Mobile Banking]---, CASE WHEN CUST.ORGKEY IN (SELECT CIF_NO FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB WHERE SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END [Mobile Banking]
               , 'TBD' [Online Banking]---, CASE WHEN CUST.ORGKEY IN (SELECT CUST_ID FROM EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION WHERE SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END [Online Banking]
               , CONSENT.STRTEXT13 AS [Data Privacy Consent]
               , CUST.BANK_ID [Bank ID]
               , CASE WHEN LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'R' THEN 'Retail' WHEN LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'C' THEN 'Corporate' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS [Customer Type]
               , CUST.CORE_CUST_ID AS [CUST_ID]
               , CUST.SCD_Start_Date AS [Validity Start Date]
               , CUST.SCD_End_Date AS [Validity End Date]
               , CUST.SOURCE_CODE
FROM EDS.Customer_Dim AS CUST
    INNER JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL AS CTL
        ON CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_Start_Date AND CUST.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY ADDRESSID DESC) AS [Rank], * FROM EDS.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31') A WHERE [Rank] = 1) AS ADDRESS
        ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = ADDRESS.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = ADDRESS.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
        ---AND PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' 
        ---AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31'
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN ADDRESS.SCD_Start_Date AND ADDRESS.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL AS EMAIL
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = EMAIL.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = EMAIL.BANK_ID
        AND EMAIL.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL'
        AND EMAIL.PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y'
        AND EMAIL.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN EMAIL.SCD_Start_Date AND EMAIL.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL AS PHONE
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = PHONE.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = PHONE.BANK_ID
        AND PHONE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' 
        AND PHONE.PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y'
        AND PHONE.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN PHONE.SCD_Start_Date AND PHONE.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC AS DEMOGRAPHIC
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = DEMOGRAPHIC.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = DEMOGRAPHIC.BANK_ID
        AND DEMOGRAPHIC.MARITAL_STATUS <> ''
        AND DEMOGRAPHIC.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_Start_Date AND DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY MISCELLANEOUSID DESC) AS [Rank], * FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT') A WHERE [Rank] = 1) AS OCCUPATION
        ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = OCCUPATION.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = OCCUPATION.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = OCCUPATION.BANK_ID
        ---AND OCCUPATION.TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN OCCUPATION.SCD_Start_Date AND OCCUPATION.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY MISCELLANEOUSID DESC) AS [Rank], * FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE TYPE = 'Risk_Type') A WHERE [Rank] = 1) AS RISKRATING
        ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = RISKRATING.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = RISKRATING.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = RISKRATING.BANK_ID
        ---AND RISKRATING.TYPE = 'Risk_Type'
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN RISKRATING.SCD_Start_Date AND RISKRATING.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY MISCELLANEOUSID DESC) AS [Rank], * FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE TYPE = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE') A WHERE [Rank] = 1) AS CONSENT
        ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = CONSENT.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = CONSENT.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = CONSENT.BANK_ID
        ---AND CONSENT.TYPE = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE'
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CONSENT.SCD_Start_Date AND CONSENT.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_AMLKYC AS AMLKYC
        ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = AMLKYC.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = AMLKYC.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = AMLKYC.BANK_ID
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN AMLKYC.SCD_Start_Date AND AMLKYC.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_GENDER MV_GENDER
        ON MV_GENDER.[VALUE] = CUST.GENDER
        AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MV_GENDER.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_GENDER.SCD_End_Date
    ---LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY
    ---    ON MV_CITY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.CITY
    ---    AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MV_CITY.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_CITY.SCD_End_Date
    ---LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE
    ---    ON MV_STATE.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
    ---    AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MV_STATE.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_STATE.SCD_End_Date
    ---LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_COUNTRY
    ---    ON MV_COUNTRY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
    ---    AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MV_COUNTRY.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_COUNTRY.SCD_End_Date
WHERE CUST.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'R' AND CUST.ORGKEY <> 'R01435724';
GO
